managementTone.evidenceNotes: CEO Eddie Wu articulated granular operating timelines for Qwen model monetization and TTG customer take-rate recovery via the 0.6% software fee. Chairman Joe Tsai outlined balanced capital allocation priorities between AI infrastructure CapEx and aggressive share repurchases, while transparently answering questions regarding macro thrift and cross-border tariffs.

topTopics.topic: CMR take-rate trajectory and merchant acceptance of 0.6% software service fee
topTopics.managementResponse: Clear & Confident — CEO Eddie Wu confirmed merchant pushback has been minimal due to offsetting fee concessions on lower-volume tiers and automated ROI gains delivered by Quanzhantui ad algorithms.

topTopics.topic: Cloud AI sustainability, high-performance GPU supply, and domestic chip alternatives
topTopics.managementResponse: Strategic — Management underscored that Alibaba Cloud's proprietary PAI heterogeneous compute scheduling and model distillation frameworks reduce reliance on restricted foreign silicon while maximizing token throughput.

topTopics.topic: AIDC international commerce cash burn and potential elimination of US/EU de minimis parcel exemptions
topTopics.managementResponse: Pragmatic — CFO Toby Xu highlighted that AliExpress Choice has already diversified transit corridors into Latin America, Japan, and the Middle East, while expanding local-to-local warehouse inventory.

topTopics.topic: Pace of share repurchases, dividend yield sustainability, and Southbound Connect liquidity
topTopics.managementResponse: Decisive — Chairman Joe Tsai affirmed the board's commitment to returning substantial free cash flow to shareholders, with dual-primary HKEX listing providing enduring institutional support.

keyQuotes.speaker: Eddie Wu
keyQuotes.context: Opening remarks on strategic execution across core e-commerce and AI cloud.
keyQuotes.quote: Our user-first and AI-driven initiatives are bearing clear fruit. Cloud Intelligence achieved double-digit top-line acceleration powered by triple-digit growth in public cloud AI products, while core Taobao and Tmall monetization has reached an undeniable turning point.

keyQuotes.speaker: Joe Tsai
keyQuotes.context: Addressing capital allocation, non-core asset divestitures, and shareholder returns.
keyQuotes.quote: We have simplified our corporate structure, systematically monetized non-core physical retail holdings, and redirected our massive operating cash flows into share repurchases and AI infrastructure. Intrinsic value will inevitably be recognized by long-term capital.

keyQuotes.speaker: Toby Xu
keyQuotes.context: Financial breakdown on operating earnings quality and segment loss reductions.
keyQuotes.quote: Clean operating income expanded 8.5% year-over-year as AIDC unit economics improved dramatically and domestic customer management take rates stabilized. Our balance sheet remains an extraordinary fortress with over $60 billion in net cash.
